title: TwinDesk: free Synergy alternative
caption:
Synergy charges $49 to share one mouse between computers. TwinDesk does it for free 🖱️

✅ One mouse and keyboard across your Mac, PC and Linux box
✅ Shared clipboard, plus drag files between computers
✅ Android calls, texts and notifications on your computer
✅ iPhone joins through the browser, no app needed. No account, no cloud

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux · Android · iPhone
ℹ️ The apps aren't code-signed, so macOS and Windows ask you to allow it on first launch. iPhone works through a web page, or a sideloaded app via AltStore. Synergy's $49 is the one-time Lite licence for up to 3 computers

Comment "DESK" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
